items.heading: NPMA
items.text: QualityPro is the pest control industry's own accreditation program, endorsed by the National Pest Management Association. Find and verify a company's accreditation before you hire.

items.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M7 3h7l4 4v14a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H7a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4"/><path d="M9 13h6M9 17h6M9 9h2"/></svg>
items.heading: EPA
items.text: The federal government's own guide to choosing a pest control method and using pesticides safely around your home and family.

items.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 4h16v12H8l-4 4V4z"/><path d="M8 9h8M8 12.5h5"/></svg>
items.heading: NPIC
items.text: A free, independent hotline run jointly with the EPA and staffed by specialists who can answer specific questions about a pesticide or treatment method before you agree to it.

items.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 21s7-7.5 7-12A7 7 0 0 0 5 9c0 4.5 7 12 7 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9" r="2.5"/></svg>
items.heading: AAPCO
items.text: The national association of state pesticide regulators. Use it to find your own state's licensing agency and confirm a company's applicator license is current.

items.heading: BBB
items.text: Look up any pest control company's complaint history, customer reviews, and accreditation status — a free, independent check before you hire.
